**Alibaba Cloud help doc search v0.0.3: major update — now supports both Chinese and international documentation, with expanded language support and internal modularization.**

- Added support for multilingual search and retrieval on both help.aliyun.com (cn) and www.alibabacloud.com (intl) portals, enabling queries in zh, en, tc, ja, id, pt-br, and experimental fr.
- Introduced new command-line flags: `--site` (cn/intl) and `--lang` (lang code), allowing precise selection of portal and language for all search/browse/read commands.
- All document operations (`search`, `read`, `list-products`, `list-docs`) may now target either portal and any supported language, with careful handling of index/search limitations for certain languages.
- Internal refactor: search/read logic modularized into multiple scripts (`help_core.py`, `help_query.py`, `help_search.py`, etc.) for better maintainability and clearer site/language boundaries.
- Updated SKILL.md to document new capability boundaries, full site/l

alibabacloud-help-doc-search 0.0.2

- Expanded skill triggers and clarified usage scenarios in the description.
- Added usage guidance to not use the skill for resource changes or incident diagnosis when a dedicated diagnosis skill is present.
- Introduced metadata keywords in Chinese and English for improved search and discoverability.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Updated and clarified documentation for better alignment with current workflows and best practices.

Initial release of alibabacloud-help-doc-search.

- Enables relevance-ranked search of Alibaba Cloud official help documentation, with optional product filtering for precision.
- Supports reading and retrieving full document content in Markdown.
- Can browse the complete product catalog and document lists by product.
- Provides OpenAPI contract verification, checking parameters, error codes, and permission points against authoritative metadata.
- Clearly distinguishes between narrative documentation and live API metadata for accuracy.
- Includes robust guidance for error handling, ECS workflows, and query construction to ensure reliable answers.
